L06.text: A03补真实磁盘证据：1874资源/1817hash共878440787字节，三历史清单全为当前子集，过时可回收0；刷新/浏览器重启不重下，活动Blob在清测试缓存正文和断网后实际恢复。跨版本无自动预算/驱逐，索引release不能作为安全删除依据；策略明确交D04，离线唯一恢复源继续保留。

failures.detail: First draft used all 2162 records / 2077 files in the asset source catalog. This exceeded the frozen released selection. Corrected before any browser scenario to the exact 1874 donor-package IDs and hashes; original draft outputs retained.

Local Chrome navigation ERR_NETWORK_ACCESS_DENIED under sandbox; zero scenario stages. Authorized retry outside that restriction completed as persistent-2. This was not an automatic approval-review rejection.
Intentional single-file CacheStorage deletion, server 503, same-length corrupt cached bytes and subsequent retries retained separately from ordinary loading.
Original 7A 148/595/606-of-929 failures retained. A03 reproduces the same symptom and isolates a browser pressure-eviction mechanism; exact pressure events in old runs were not captured.
After 1566 successful hits, only 141 keys remained; 1425 prior keys absent. This is retained as a storage-retention failure, despite successful gameplay and context recovery.
Whole-release prefetch failed before any pressure notification. Original low-level exception was not recorded; do not label it retrospectively from the next run.
Whole-release prefetch captured QuotaExceededError around 856 MB while estimate.quota reported around 11.59 GB. Formal pressure comparison uses the independently established 515 MB main-game subset.
